subject: Post-call: CloverData usage review & proposed Dedicated pilot (next steps)
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@cloverdata.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@cloverdata.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T15:12:00-04:00
Subject: Follow-up from today - usage signals and main asks

Thanks for a productive call today. Quick notes from our side to make sure we captured everything correctly:

- Current usage: ~4M inference tokens/day (mostly RAG retrieval + summarization), with a heavy evening peak (19:00-22:00 ET).
- Pain points: latency spikes during peak (long tail up to 2.1s per token), rising per-token spend (we're seeing 28% MoM), and needing stronger audit logs for upcoming SOC2 re-audit.
- New workload interest: real-time meeting summarization and multi-doc RAG for customer support triage — lower latency target (<=300ms p50) and strict PII handling.
- Business goal: reduce per-token cost and shave tail latency while keeping output quality for summarization at current thresholds.

Next steps from our side: please send the detailed usage export (by endpoint + token bands) and a rough pilot proposal (Dedicated or Reserved) with estimated cost delta and timeline. We can confirm stakeholders for procurement and security; Rajiv will loop the security team with the questionnaire.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Platform Engineering
CloverData

Attachments: security_questionnaire_filled.pdf (requested on call)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@cloverdata.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T18:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today - usage signals and main asks

Elena — thanks for the clear summary and for confirming the stakeholders.  I pulled the usage dump and a few quick signal counts and attached the Q1 export (usage_report_Q1.csv). High-level recap and proposed next steps below so we have alignment: 

What we heard (concise):
- Heavy RAG/summarization workload with evening peak; long-tail latency spikes at peak.
- Cost is growing faster than value capture; you want a path to reduce per-token unit cost.
- Compliance: need audit-grade logs and proof points for SOC2 scope.

Short proposal (Pilot path):
1) Two-week Dedicated pilot scoped to match your evening peak profile (estimated 2x current baseline capacity) so we can measure steady-state and tail latency improvements.
2) Instrumentation + tracing during pilot and Redwood console access for token-level cost/latency breakdowns.
3) Security checklist handoff (we'll provide redacted logs and retention settings that match SOC2 needs).
4) Deliverable at end of pilot: cost delta analysis, latency SLOs observed, recommended production sizing and quantization profile.

Estimated timeline: kickoff within 7 business days after mutual agreement; pilot 2 weeks; results review within 3 business days post-pilot.

Ask from you: confirmation of final pilot stakeholders (procurement, security, and an engineering owner) and sign-off on the proposed pilot window. Also please confirm whether a temporary non-prod VPC or your VPC is preferred for the pilot.

I'll also attach a short SOW outline and an initial draft of MSA redlines for legal to review (SOW_outline.docx, draft_MSA_redlines.pdf).

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: usage_report_Q1.csv, SOW_outline.docx, draft_MSA_redlines.pdf

From: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@cloverdata.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up from today - usage signals and main asks

Vivek — thanks for the proposal and for the report. Quick answers:

- Stakeholders: I'll own the engineering side and will bring on procurement (names TBD) and security (cc'd).
- Security: we'll want to see retention controls and access logs; security team will review your questionnaire.
- Cost question: can you provide a ballpark of the expected incremental monthly cost for the two-week pilot and a projection for steady-state Dedicated vs Hosted? We need numbers to make the procurement case.

Proposed kickoff window: April 7th (we have an internal release April 2-6).

—Rajiv
VP Engineering, CloverData

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-30T12:15:00-04:00
Subject: FW: Follow-up from today - usage signals and main asks

(Internal) Lauren/Tessa — forwarding CloverData thread and report. Key asks:
- Rajiv wants a ballpark incremental cost for the two-week pilot and steady-state Dedicated vs Hosted projection for their procurement ask.
- They prefer an April 7th kickoff.

Numbers I pulled from the usage export (back-of-envelope):
- Current baseline monthly (hosted): ~$13.2k/mo token spend (their reported 4M tokens/day).
- Pilot (2 weeks Dedicated sized for evening peak): estimated incremental platform cost ~ $6.5k for the pilot window (includes reserved capacity for peak hours + monitoring).
- Steady-state Dedicated projection (matched to pilot sizing): estimated monthly spend ~$21k/mo (includes reserved capacity + support SLA).

Recommendation: offer a one-time 20% pilot credit to reduce friction on procurement + two-week Dedicated pilot with full console access. If procurement pushes back, we can convert pilot invoices to committed credits on an annual Dedicated commit.

Please advise if we should escalate pricing approval or if we can offer 20% pilot credit under our standard AE discount band.

Thanks,
Vivek

Attachments referenced: usage_report_Q1.csv

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@cloverdata.com>, Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@cloverdata.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-31T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today - usage signals and main asks

Elena / Rajiv — quick and actionable next email to lock timeline and deliverables: 

1) Pilot scope: Two-week Dedicated pilot scoped to cover evening peak (estimated capacity = 2x baseline). Aim: measure p50/p95 latency and get unit-cost breakdown with prefix caching and quantization profiles.
2) Timeline: Kickoff April 7 (Redwood to deliver environment + instrumentation by April 9); pilot window April 10–23; results review April 24.
3) Pricing: Pilot incremental cost = $6,500 (one-time). Recommended: Redwood offers a 20% pilot credit (final pilot invoice = $5,200) to expedite procurement. Steady-state projection: $21k/mo (estimate; will refine after pilot).
4) Compliance & security: we'll grant access to audit logs and a redacted runbook; see attached filled security questionnaire.
5) Deliverables: usage/latency dashboard access, pilot runbook, end-of-pilot cost and latency report, recommended production sizing and quantization profile.

Please reply with a one-line confirmation of: (a) stakeholder list (procurement contact), (b) agreement to pilot dates, and (c) whether you prefer Redwood-hosted non-prod or your VPC for the pilot. Once confirmed we'll route a short SOW + DocuSign for signatures.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
